description: This file declares functions, enums, and constants related to domain and registry control, specifically for handling effective TLDs, registry lengths, and domain comparisons within the Chromium project. It includes licensing information, class and function declarations, and detailed documentation on effective TLD rules.

methods.name: GetDomainAndRegistry
methods.description: Returns the registered, organization-identifying host and registry info from a GURL, Origin, or host string, based on effective TLD rules.

methods.name: SameDomainOrHost
methods.description: Checks if two GURLs or Origins have the same host or domain/registry.

methods.name: GetRegistryLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the registrar portion of the host in a GURL, considering effective TLD rules.

methods.name: HostHasRegistryControlledDomain
methods.description: Determines if a hostname has a registry-controlled domain.

methods.name: GetCanonicalHostRegistryLength
methods.description: Gets the registry length for a canonicalized host string.

methods.name: PermissiveGetHostRegistryLength
methods.description: Gets the registry length for a hostname, tolerant of invalid characters.

methods.name: ResetFindDomainGraphForTesting
methods.description: Resets domain graph for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetFindDomainGraphForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom domain graph for testing.
